name: Challenge Dominoes
description: Challenge Dominoes is an expanded-supply western domino connecting game played with two double-six sets. The duplicated tiles reduce early blocking and change inference, so play emphasizes robust end control, mobility, and managing pip exposure under uncertainty.

overview.description: Challenge Dominoes is an expanded-supply western domino connecting game played with two double-six sets. The duplicated tiles reduce early blocking and change inference, so play emphasizes robust end control, mobility, and managing pip exposure under uncertainty.

history.origins: Challenge Dominoes is encountered as a modern expanded-supply domino format that uses two standard sets to keep the layout moving at larger tables.
timeline: Modern era: circulated through social play and rules collections.
history.cultural: Played as a social table game with house scoring and blocked-turn rules agreed before play.
history.evolution: Two-set play increases duplication, weakening single-tile inference and shifting strategy toward flexible connectors and safe exits.

setup.deck: Two double-6 domino sets combined and mixed.
setup.dealing: Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
setup.equipment: Domino sets and optional score tracking.

rules.objective: Play legal tiles by matching open ends and achieve the hand-end and scoring goals defined by the table profile.
rules.gameplay: Players place one tile per turn to a legal open end of the shared layout. When blocked, the table profile determines whether to draw from a boneyard or pass. The hand ends when a player empties their hand or when no legal plays remain, and scoring follows the match rules in use.
keyRules: A played tile must match an exposed open end value.
Blocked turns resolve by the active draw-or-pass policy.
Hand-end and scoring are table-profile dependent.

strategy.basic: Keep flexible tiles and avoid being left with high-pip tiles when hands end.
strategy.intermediate: Duplicates reduce certainty, so prioritize moves that keep multiple responses available.
strategy.advanced: Control open ends to limit opponents while keeping safe exits, adjusting for lower-confidence inference.
tips: Avoid over-committing to reads that assume unique tiles.
Plan for mobility so a single blocked value does not strand your hand.

synthesis.shortDescription: Challenge Dominoes is a two double-six set connecting game where duplication changes inference and end-control strategy.
